Record bank transactions from SMS automatically
Khata can record your bank transactions from the SMS your bank sends, so there\'s almost nothing to type.
Only SMS from supported banks are read: Kotak, and banks you add in Settings > Parsers. Anyone else\'s messages are skipped without being read.
OTPs, offers and reminders are ignored.

Read SMS from more banks with rule codes from the parser website
Khata reads bank SMS with parser rules. For a bank or SMS format it doesn\'t know yet, make a rule code on the Khata parser website and add it here. Your rules are tried before the built-in ones.
None yet. Tap + to add a rule code.

It\'s for a newer version of Khata.
Its name (id) may only use a–z, 0–9 and -, up to 64 characters.
The bank name is empty or longer than 40 characters.
The senders must be 1 to 10 bank sender IDs, such as KOTAKB. Phone numbers and promotional senders aren\'t allowed.
It needs either a fixed direction or direction words, not both or neither.
The pattern is empty or longer than 1,000 characters.
The pattern uses something Khata doesn\'t allow, such as a lookahead or a backreference, or an unknown group name.
